learning_outcomes.text: understanding variational principles particularly of deformation approach
understandig FEM as particular case of Ritz's method

syllabus_topics: Deformation and force approach in mechanics

Fundamental ideas of elastostatics - tensor, index and matrix notation, variational principles: statically amissible stress, kinematically admissible strain, principle of virtual displacements. Example for 1D.
Minimum of total potential energy principle. Example for 1D.
Variational principles in mechanics - extension for 3D-continuum.
Approximate solutions - Ritz's method. Example with Fourier base and with piecewise linear base on the tension-compression bar.
Basic concepts of FEM - node, element, shape functions, u-delta operator, stiffness matrix, equivalent nodal loads
Theory of Kirchhoff plates. Plate elements, flat shell elements
bibliography: Lecturers's slides and other resources are placed in http://moodle.fs.cvut.cz.
Bathe, K.J.: Finite Element Procedures, Prentice Hall, 1996
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
